explain_tr: Aktarma fiili geçmişte olduğu için am bir adım geriye kayar: was.
prompt: “I am busy.” → He said he ___ busy yesterday.
trap_tr: She said she is ready dersen backshift unutulmuş olur.

explain_tr: Tell fiilinden sonra mutlaka kişi gelir: told me.
prompt: She ___ me she would call later.
trap_tr: He told that dersen kişi eksik kalır; said that ya da told me gerekir.

explain_tr: Dünkü aktarmada am → was olur ve that opsiyoneldir.
prompt: Pick the correct reported version of “I am tired.” (said yesterday).

explain_tr: Doğru kalıp told me ya da said (kişisiz); said me ve told that yanlıştır.
prompt: Pick the correct say/tell sentence.

explain_tr: Emir cümlesi aktarılırken told + kişi + to + fiil kullanılır.
prompt: The teacher told us ___ open our books.
trap_tr: For open yazmak Türkçe için çevirisidir; emir aktarımı to ister.

explain_tr: Yes/no soruları aktarılırken asked if/whether + düz cümle dizilimi gelir.
prompt: “Are you ready?” → He asked ___ I was ready.
trap_tr: That yazmak soru değil düz cümle aktarımı olur.

choices: He said me to close the door.
He told that to close the door.
He asked to I close the door.
He told me to close the door.
explain_tr: Emir aktarımı told me + to + fiildir; told that ve said me yanlıştır.
prompt: Pick the correct reported command for “Close the door.”

accept: He said that he lived there.
explain_tr: I → he, live → lived, here → there: üç kayma birden olur.
prompt: “I live here.” (Report it: He said ...).

explain_tr: Saw geçmişi bir adım daha geriye kayar: had seen.
prompt: “We saw it.” → They said they ___ seen it.
trap_tr: Have yazmak present perfect karıştırılmasıdır; aktarım had ister.

explain_tr: Will bir adım geriye kayar: would call.
prompt: “I will call.” → She said she ___ call.
trap_tr: Will aynen bırakılırsa backshift unutulmuş olur.

choices: She asked where did I live.
She asked me where did I lived.
explain_tr: Aktarılan soruda düz cümle dizilimi kullanılır; did I live soru dizilimidir.
prompt: Pick the correct reported question for “Where do you live?”

choices: He asked if I had finished.
He asked me did I finished.
explain_tr: Yes/no sorusu asked if + past perfect ile aktarılır: had finished.
prompt: Pick the correct reported version of “Did you finish?” (asked yesterday).
prompt_tr: "Bitirdin mi?" cümlesinin doğru aktarımını seç (dün soruldu).

explain_tr: Wh-sorusu wh kelimesini korur ama fiil geçmişe kayar: lived.
prompt: She asked me where I ___.
trap_tr: Live yazmak backshift hatasıdır; soru kipi kalktı diye zaman aynı kalmaz.

explain_tr: Olumsuz emir told + kişi + not to + fiil ile aktarılır.
prompt: “Don't be late.” → He told us ___ to be late.
trap_tr: Don't aynen taşınamaz; aktarımda not to olur.

choices: She said she saw it yesterday.
She said she has seen it yesterday.
She said she sees it the day before.
She said she had seen it the day before.
explain_tr: Saw → had seen olur ve yesterday → the day before kayar.
prompt: Pick the correct reported version of “I saw it yesterday.”

accept: He told us not to be late.
He told us not to be late that day.
answer_text: He told us not to be late.
explain_tr: Olumsuz emir not to ile aktarılır, kişi (us) korunur.
prompt: “Don't be late.” (Report it: He told us ...).
prompt_tr: Aktararak yaz (He told us ...): "Don't be late."

accept: He asked me to help him.
He asked if I could help him.
answer_text: He asked me to help him.
explain_tr: Rica iki yolla aktarılır: asked me to ya da asked if + could.
prompt: “Can you help me?” (Report it: He asked ...).
prompt_tr: Aktararak yaz (He asked ...): "Can you help me?"

explain_tr: Have finished bir adım geriye kayar: had finished.
prompt: “I have finished.” → She said she ___ finished.
trap_tr: Has yazmak özne kaymasıdır; she said sonrası she için had gerekir.

explain_tr: Will → would olur ve tomorrow → the next day kayar.
prompt: “I will come tomorrow.” → He said he would come ___.
trap_tr: Tomorrow aynen bırakılırsa zaman kayması unutulmuş olur.

explain_tr: Dün konuşulduysa is → was kayar; is ready bugünün değil dünün cümlesidir.
prompt: She spoke yesterday. Pick the correct sentence.

choices: He told that he was ill.
He said that he was ill.
He said me that he was ill.
explain_tr: Tek doğru said that ya da told me that; told that ve said me asla olmaz.
prompt: Pick the only correct say/tell sentence.

choices: My mum said I have to tidy my room.
My mum told that I tidy my room.
My mum said I had to tidy my room.
My mum said me to tidy my room.
explain_tr: Must/have to aktarımda had to olur; told that ve said me yanlıştır.
prompt: “You must tidy your room.” (Mum said it yesterday.) Pick the correct report.
prompt_tr: "Odanı topla." (Annem dün söyledi.) Doğru aktarımı seç.

choices: They asked what time did the train leave.
They asked what time the train left.
They asked that the train left.
They asked the train what time left.
explain_tr: Aktarılan soruda wh korunur, dizilim düz cümledir: the train left.
prompt: Pick the correct reported question for “What time does the train leave?”
prompt_tr: "Tren saat kaçta kalkıyor?" sorusunun doğru aktarımını seç.

accept: She said she had seen her the day before.
She said that she had seen her the day before.
answer_text: She said she had seen her the day before.
explain_tr: Saw → had seen ve yesterday → the day before: çifte kayma gerekir.
prompt: “I saw her yesterday.” (Report it: She said ...).
prompt_tr: Aktararak yaz (She said ...): "I saw her yesterday."

accept: She told us not to shout.
She told us not to shout then.
answer_text: She told us not to shout.
explain_tr: Olumsuz emir not to ile aktarılır; shout yalın kalır.
prompt: “Don't shout.” (Report it: She told us ...).
